listing.style: 1954 mid-century post-and-beam ranch, largely original time capsule
listing.description: Mid Century View Home in the Hills. Perched in the Oakland Hills, this distinctive residence blends mid-century character, timeless craftsmanship, and generous proportions. A welcoming front patio leads into an interior rich with architectural detail, including high ceilings, beautiful wood-paneled walls, and original period features that lend warmth and character throughout. At the heart of the home, an expansive living room features a brick fireplace and oversized windows framing impressive views. The main level offers three bedrooms and one and a half baths, along with an original kitchen featuring a dining nook that also takes advantage of the outlook. The lower level adds valuable flexibility with a spacious rumpus room, complete with its own kitchenette and ample storage. With direct access to the outdoors, this versatile space offers possibilities for entertaining, recreation, creative pursuits, or additional gathering space. Set on an expansive lot, the outdoor spaces include a generous patio ideal for dining and entertaining, surrounded by a lush garden setting. Additional features include a one-car garage and convenient access to the shops, restaurants, and neighborhood amenities of Glenview and Montclair. A home with architectural character, remarkable views, and flexible living spaces, offering a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of the Oakland Hills. *sq. ft and room count differ from public records

verdict: This house IS the trade: an authentic 1954 post-and-beam time capsule with genuine bay views and a flexible walk-out lower level, in exchange for a fully vintage kitchen and pink bath, one full bathroom for three bedrooms, close neighbors on the uphill side, and real fire-country homework (confirmed Very High FHSZ, dry slopes, flat roof, gravity furnace). For the MCM purist who budgets for systems and defensible space, it's the rare honest listing; for anyone wanting turnkey, it's a project.
